scripts.dev: pnpm build:libs && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @aom/server dev" "pnpm --filter @aom/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:libs && pnpm --filter @aom/server build && pnpm --filter @aom/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:libs && pnpm --filter @aom/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @aom/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm build:libs && pnpm --filter @aom/server build && pnpm --filter @aom/server test
